summary: Build a practical transformation office, governance model, and reporting pack in 5 days. Ideal for PMO and transformation leaders.
lede: Digital transformation office governance helps PMO and change professionals coordinate initiatives and oversee portfolio controls. The course covers defining an office charter and decision rights, establishing governance forums and escalation routes, and creating dashboards to track milestones, dependencies, risks and benefits. Learners also practice preparing governance calendars and executive reporting packs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who help structure, coordinate, and report digital change portfolios. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for transformation oversight, governance routines, executive updates, or benefits tracking.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in project, programme, portfolio, change, or digital delivery environments, along with a basic understanding of governance reporting and cross-functional coordination. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools, portfolio status reporting, or PMO routines will help you get more value from the exercises. Coding is not required. Advanced governance concepts are taught at an operational application level, with selected topics introduced at conceptual awareness level where full implementation would require a larger transformation programme.
